items.source:
Determine whether there are currently thread-bound credentials,
using them if available, falling back to the statically specified
username and password (i.e. values of the bean properties) else.
items.translation: 确定当前是否存在线程绑定的凭据，如果可用则使用它们；否则回退到静态指定的用户名和密码（即 Bean 属性的值）。

items.translation: username - 要使用的用户名

items.source: password - the password to use
items.translation: password - 要使用的密码

items.source: the Connection
items.translation: 连接

items.source: If the "username" is empty, this proxy will simply delegate to the standard createConnection() or createContext() method of the target ConnectionFactory. This can be used to keep a UserCredentialsConnectionFactoryAdapter bean definition just for the option of implicitly passing in user credentials if the particular target ConnectionFactory requires it.
items.translation: 如果"username"为空，此代理将简单地委派给目标 `ConnectionFactory` 的 `createConnection()` 或 `createContext()` 标准方法。这可用于仅保留一个 `UserCredentialsConnectionFactoryAdapter` Bean 定义，以便在特定目标 `ConnectionFactory` 需要时，隐式传递用户凭据的选项。

items.source: Can be used to proxy a target JNDI ConnectionFactory that does not have user credentials configured. Client code can work with the ConnectionFactory without passing in username and password on every createConnection() and createContext() call.
items.translation: 可用于代理未配置用户凭据的目标 JNDI ConnectionFactory。客户端代码可以在每次调用 `createConnection()` 和 `createContext()` 时，无需传入用户名和密码即可使用 ConnectionFactory。

items.source:
In the following example, client code can simply transparently work
with the preconfigured "myConnectionFactory", implicitly accessing
"myTargetConnectionFactory" with the specified user credentials.
items.translation: 在以下示例中，客户端代码可以简单地透明地使用预配置的"myConnectionFactory"，并隐式地以指定的用户凭据访问"myTargetConnectionFactory"。

items.source: This implementation delegates to the createConnection(username, password) method of the target ConnectionFactory, passing in the specified user credentials. If the specified username is empty, it will simply delegate to the standard createConnection() method of the target ConnectionFactory.
items.translation: 此实现会委托给目标 ConnectionFactory 的 createConnection(username, password) 方法，并传入指定的用户凭据。如果指定的用户名为空，则它将简单地委托给目标 ConnectionFactory 的标准 createConnection() 方法。

items.source: This implementation delegates to the createQueueConnection(username, password) method of the target QueueConnectionFactory, passing in the specified user credentials. If the specified username is empty, it will simply delegate to the standard createQueueConnection() method of the target ConnectionFactory.
items.translation: 此实现会委托给目标 `QueueConnectionFactory` 的 `createQueueConnection(username, password)` 方法，并传入指定的用户凭据。如果指定的用户名为空，则它将直接委托给目标 `ConnectionFactory` 的标准 `createQueueConnection()` 方法。

items.source: This implementation delegates to the createTopicConnection(username, password) method of the target TopicConnectionFactory, passing in the specified user credentials. If the specified username is empty, it will simply delegate to the standard createTopicConnection() method of the target ConnectionFactory.
items.translation: 此实现会委托给目标 TopicConnectionFactory 的 createTopicConnection(username, password) 方法，并传入指定的用户凭据。如果指定的用户名为空，则它将直接委托给目标 ConnectionFactory 的标准 createTopicConnection() 方法。

items.source: Delegate the call straight to the target ConnectionFactory.
items.translation: 将调用直接委托给目标 ConnectionFactory。

items.source: Delegate the call straight to the target QueueConnectionFactory.
items.translation: 将调用直接委托给目标 QueueConnectionFactory。

items.source: Delegate the call straight to the target TopicConnectionFactory.
items.translation: 将调用直接委托给目标 TopicConnectionFactory。

items.translation: 设置此 ConnectionFactory 应委托的目标 ConnectionFactory。

items.source:

Default is no specific password.

items.source: As of Spring Framework 5, this class delegates JMS 2.0 JMSContext calls and therefore requires the JMS 2.0 API to be present at runtime. It may nevertheless run against a JMS 1.1 driver (bound to the JMS 2.0 API) as long as no actual JMS 2.0 calls are triggered by the application's setup.
items.translation: 自 Spring Framework 5 起，该类委托了 JMS 2.0 `JMSContext` 调用，因此需要在运行时存在 JMS 2.0 API。尽管如此，只要应用程序的配置不会触发实际的 JMS 2.0 调用，它仍可与绑定到 JMS 2.0 API 的 JMS 1.1 驱动程序一起运行。

items.source:
This method allows the bean instance to perform validation of its overall
configuration and final initialization when all bean properties have been set.
items.translation: 此方法允许 Bean 实例在其所有属性设置完成后，执行其整体配置验证和最终初始化。

items.source:
This will override any statically specified user credentials,
that is, values of the "username" and "password" bean properties.
items.translation: 这将覆盖任何静态指定的用户凭据，即"username"和"password"bean 属性的值。

items.source: Invoked by the containing BeanFactory after it has set all bean properties and satisfied BeanFactoryAware, ApplicationContextAware etc.
items.translation: 由包含的BeanFactory在设置所有 bean 属性并满足BeanFactoryAware、ApplicationContextAware等接口后调用。
